hypothesis: Preference optimization on complete autonomous same-map, same-seat terminal games can transfer some native replanned search strength into a direct observation-conditioned policy where atomic and cached-plan imitation failed.
arena: Classic Generic procedural_v2 11x9 two-player, 2400-action limit, all root seats, no material-adjudicated game counted as terminal
teacher: Native three-turn search root256/slate8/opponent64/followup32, beam32/branch48, replanned at every atomic action
collection: For each fit, calibration and offline-validation map, play one frozen-source selfplay game and two games with one root seat controlled by the native replanned teacher against the frozen source. Save ordered acting seats and legal action indices, terminal/truncated flags and winner. Replay every trace from a fresh map and require exact final outcome. A same-map, same-root-seat pair is informative only when both games are terminal and their root-seat winners differ. Keep source-preferred as well as teacher-preferred pairs. Never query final outcomes or native search inside student inference.
student: Initialize both routed-v6 seat experts from the exact frozen reference. Train all parameters that influence action logits, including the spatial encoder and action scorer; do not train an auxiliary value or outcome head. Keep the direct observation, legal-action interface and model shape unchanged.
objective: For each terminal informative pair, score only the root seat's actions along each complete saved trajectory. The trajectory log ratio is the unnormalized sum over those actions of log student probability minus log frozen-reference probability under each replayed state and its complete legal action set. Minimize softplus(-0.02 times (preferred trajectory log ratio minus dispreferred trajectory log ratio)). Do not divide by action count, add atomic teacher cross-entropy, or use heuristic or terminal-state labels at an individual action. This is a trajectory probability-ratio preference objective; paired branches can visit different states and have different lengths.
optimization: Exactly two epochs, map order shuffled with seed6561000, one AdamW update per informative map using the mean of its one or two seat-pair losses, learning rate0.00001, weight decay0.01, global gradient-norm clip1.0, torch deterministic CPU mode and one thread. Compute exact full-trajectory log ratios without retaining whole-game autograd graphs, then replay the same states to accumulate their analytically weighted gradients before the map update. No calibration or validation tuning of architecture, objective, optimizer, epoch, beta, learning rate or thresholds.
resource_calibration_gate: After implementation tests and before the full fit, use the disjoint 8-map calibration window only to prove trace integrity, numerical equality of streaming and non-streaming pair gradients on a small replay, one-map update completion, and bounded runtime/memory. Do not select hyperparameters from its outcome counts or use its trajectories for fitting. Stop if one-core estimate exceeds 3600 seconds for fit, peak resident memory exceeds 4 GiB, or replay/gradient equivalence fails.
fit_data_gate: Require all 384 fit games and trace replays complete, zero censored map-seat pairs, at least 64 informative pairs total and at least 24 informative pairs in each root seat. If this availability gate fails, stop without training; do not change map count or seeds.
offline_validation_gate: On the untouched 64-map window require all 192 games and trace replays complete, zero censored pairs, at least 24 informative pairs, strictly positive candidate complete-trajectory log-ratio preference margin on more independent maps than negative with an exact two-sided map-grouped sign-test p<0.05, positive-minus-negative informative-pair count nonnegative in each root seat, and mean frozen-reference-to-candidate action KL no more than0.05 nats on all replayed root-seat decisions. Source has zero log-ratio margin by definition. Failure stops all game gates; do not tune on these results.
direct_model_game_gate: Only after passing offline validation, play candidate versus the frozen reference on fresh 128 maps with both candidate seats, and also replay frozen-source selfplay on those maps for matched map/seat outcomes. Require all 384 games terminal, candidate beats the corresponding reference seat outcome on more independent maps than it loses with exact two-sided map-grouped p<0.05, nonnegative candidate advantage in each seat, and one-core median per-decision CPU no more than1.5 times the frozen reference on matched observations. Count every timeout, crash or nonterminal as failure, never as a candidate win. No Elo claim before this gate.
native_teacher_game_gate: Only after the direct-model gate, play candidate and frozen reference separately against the same native replanned teacher on fresh 128 maps and both root seats. Require all 512 games terminal, candidate wins at least25 percent of its 256 games, at least20 percent within each seat, and candidate improves on the frozen reference by an independent-map exact two-sided sign-test p<0.05. Record native-search versus candidate CPU and zero-censor status. The teacher is an opponent in complete games, not an online oracle for candidate decisions.
final_promotion_gate: Only after all earlier gates, predeclare the fixed candidate checkpoint hash and run untouched 256-map both-seat direct-reference and native-teacher complete-game confirmation, plus Online Default and Classic Slay profile/runtime checks. Require no censor in Classic Generic, positive exact map-grouped sign tests versus reference in both Classic Generic confirmation matchups, positive results in both seats, and acceptable browser WASM latency before any optional browser promotion. Classic Slay nonterminal games must be reported as finite-horizon, never terminal wins. Report only actual fixed-pool paired Elo with map-bootstrap uncertainty, never global Elo.
stop_rules: One checkpoint and one fixed run only. No alternate epochs, beta, loss normalization, seed reuse, threshold tuning, validation window retesting, reserved earlier student-game windows, rated-bot change or Site promotion after a failed gate. Feasibility seed6560000 is excluded permanently. Preserve the original game mechanics and geometry.
compute: Heavy work only on SSH server fedora-toolbox scratch, not the dirty original remote repo or local machine; one CPU15 pinned nice19 with Rayon/BLAS one thread, bounded outputs and no parallel heavy job. Check shared CPU, memory, swap and disk before each phase and do not preempt other work.
